description: This file defines the SimpleMouseRotator class, a Unity MonoBehaviour that manages mouse or mobile input to rotate a game object within specified constraints, supporting both relative and absolute input modes.

classes.name: SimpleMouseRotator
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour that enables constrained rotation of a game object based on mouse or mobile input, with configurable rotation range, speed, and damping.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the original rotation of the game object.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Handles input reading, angle calculations, clamping, and applies smooth rotation to the game object each frame.
